source.name: Manchester United – 'Betway announced as Official Principal Partner'
source.quote: The agreement, which begins with the 2026/27 season, sees the partnership with Manchester United become Betway’s biggest sponsorship investment to date

note: Multi-year deal from 2026/27; Betway is Official Principal Partner and Exclusive Global Betting Partner, with the logo on the training kits of the men's and women's teams. The club announcement gives no value; Score and Change (17 Sep 2026) reports 'over £20 million per year' with no linked source, so no value is recorded.
